institution: All India Institute of Medical Sciences, Jodhpur
period: 2022 to 2023 (printed as 'Institute Antibiogram 2022-2023'; months not stated)
citation: All India Institute of Medical Sciences, Jodhpur. Antimicrobial Policy (January 2024), section 4: Institute Antibiogram 2022-2023, pp. 12 to 17. Jodhpur: AIIMS Jodhpur; 2024.
reporting: Percent susceptible. OPD table (p12): %S only, no isolate numbers. Salmonella, IPD Enterobacteriaceae, IPD A. baumannii and P. aeruginosa by specimen, and Gram-positive tables (pp13 to 15): susceptible/tested with %S and n per organism column; cells with fewer than 30 isolates are marked * with no percentage. ICU blood and respiratory tables (pp16 to 17): susceptible, total tested and %S per drug, no n per organism.

verification.note: p12 parsed from the PDF text layer and compared value by value with the rendered page. pp13 to 17 have no text layer (tables are embedded images): read from page images in two independent passes, pass 1 from the embedded table images upscaled 2 to 3x, pass 2 from the pages rendered at scale 3 to 5 and cropped into different column and row groups. Only values both passes agreed on are recorded (all agreed). Every susceptible/tested pair was also checked against its printed percentage; five printed percentages disagree with their own counts (ICU blood E. coli aztreonam and imipenem, ICU blood K. pneumoniae ciprofloxacin, ICU respiratory A. baumannii and Pseudomonas amikacin) and are recorded as printed; the four material ones carry a conflict entry and the imipenem slip (61.55% printed, 61.54% by count) a per-drug note. Every cell the validator did not keep was re-read on the page image afterwards and matches the source.

notes: Institute Antibiogram 2022-2023 (pages 12 to 17) of the AIIMS Jodhpur Antimicrobial Policy dated January 2024. The data period is printed only as 2022-2023, without months (it may be a calendar or a financial year), so no end month is given. Tables: OPD Gram positives and Gram negatives from various samples (p12, %S only); OPD Salmonella (p13, specimen not stated); IPD Enterobacteriaceae from various samples (p14); IPD A. baumannii and P. aeruginosa by specimen, except faeces (p15); Gram positives from various samples, S. aureus, MSSA, MRSA and Enterococcus (p15, setting not stated, recorded as all settings); ICU blood Gram negatives, MSSA, Enterococcus and Candida, and ICU respiratory Gram negatives (pp16 to 17, isolate numbers not printed). IPD is recorded as wards, 'various samples' and 'All Specimens' as all specimens, LRT as respiratory, superficial infection as pus, deep infection as deep. Cells printed as 0/0 (no isolate tested) and cells marked * with (-) (fewer than 30 tested, no percentage printed) are left out; no percentage was computed from counts. Several ICU percentages are truncated rather than rounded in the source (e.g. 1/29 printed 3.4%); they are recorded as printed. The live AIIMS Jodhpur site was unreachable at retrieval; the PDF was downloaded from the Internet Archive copy of the same URL (snapshot 2025-08-31).

issues: Second reader 2026-09-26: all 450 cells, all 394 per-drug numbers tested and all 46 rows (organism, specimen, setting, n) re-read against the page images (p12 rendered at scale 3; pp13 to 17 from the embedded table images, upscaled 1.4 to 2.2x and cropped by column group), each value read before it was compared with the extraction; 0 value, number-tested, n or stratum errors.

The 4 conflicts are printed that way, not misreadings: ICU blood E. coli aztreonam 5 of 9 printed 63%, ICU blood K. pneumoniae ciprofloxacin 2 of 29 printed 3.7%, ICU respiratory A. baumannii amikacin 9 of 165 printed 5.04%, ICU respiratory Pseudomonas amikacin 12 of 25 printed 44.44%. The ICU blood E. coli imipenem slip (16 of 26 printed 61.55%) is also as printed. Every other susceptible/tested pair on pp13 to 17 gives its printed percentage (truncated or rounded).

All 26 cells the validator does not keep are as printed: 18 cautions (cefotaxime against ceftriaxone for E. coli OPD and IPD, C. koseri, K. oxytoca, S. marcescens, P. rettgeri and P. stuartii; the 4 conflicts), 7 intrinsic (E. faecalis OPD clindamycin 64.1; nitrofurantoin 0 for P. mirabilis, M. morganii, P. rettgeri and P. stuartii; P. stuartii minocycline 0; ICU blood Enterococcus gentamicin 6 of 28), 1 suppressed (MRSA cefoxitin 8 of 265, printed -3).

Corrected the 4 A. baumannii IPD row notes: they said minocycline was printed *0/0, but minocycline is printed for A. baumannii (blood 20/43, LRT 89/226, superficial 18/35, deep 15/26); only polymyxin B is *0/0. No value changed.

Stratum note for the lead: the p15 Gram-positive table (S. aureus, MSSA, MRSA, Enterococcus) prints no setting ('Antibiogram of Gram positives isolated from various samples', placed after the IPD Gram-negative tables); kept as all settings as extracted, but it may be inpatients only.
